This Asset will be kept secure but poised, ready to assist us with future operations - particularly when we might brush up against diplomatic or governmental issues.

texts.zh: 间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]从[from.target.GetName]发回报告：到目前为止此项计划进展顺利。我们的间谍网现在能支持我们连接部分[from.target.GetName]用于运算的网络。如果我们要掩盖自己对于机器实体的行动，传送错误的信息或是开展其他干扰的话，我们可以将其自身的协议武器化来对付它自己。
texts.en: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports from the [from.target.GetName]: a successful execution so far. Our Spy Network is now bolstered by access to part of the network on which the [from.target.GetName] operates. Should we wish to obscure our movements against the machine entity, send it false information or otherwise interfere with it: its own protocols may now be weaponized against it.
